versions.subject: fix: split mavinject rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName:
        - 'mavinject32.exe'
        - 'mavinject64.exe'
filter:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\mavinject32.exe'
        - '\mavinject64.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
